sentences.text: Ariana Grande-Butera -LRB- born June 26 , 1993 -RRB- , known as Ariana Grande -LRB- -LSB- ˌɑriˈɑːnə_ˈɡrɑːndeɪ -RSB- -RRB- , is an American singer and actress .

She began her career in the Broadway musical 13 , before landing the role of Cat Valentine in the Nickelodeon television series Victorious in 2009 .	Broadway	Broadway theatre	13	13 (musical)	Cat Valentine	Cat Valentine (Victorious)	Nickelodeon	Nickelodeon	Victorious	Victorious
The show ended after four seasons , and Grande starred in the spinoff , Sam & Cat , which ended in 2014 .	spinoff	Spin-off (media)	Sam & Cat	Sam & Cat
She has also appeared in other theatre and television roles , and has lent her voice to animated television and films .
Grande 's music career began with the soundtrack Music from Victorious -LRB- 2011 -RRB- .	Victorious	Victorious	soundtrack	soundtrack	Music from Victorious	Victorious: Music from the Hit TV Show

She signed a recording contract with Republic Records and released her debut studio album , Yours Truly , in 2013 , which debuted at number one on the US Billboard 200 .	Republic	Republic Records	Republic Records	Republic Records	Yours Truly	Yours Truly (Ariana Grande album)

The album 's lead single , `` The Way '' , debuted in the top 10 of the Billboard Hot 100 , with critics comparing her wide vocal range to that of Mariah Carey .	The Way	The Way (Ariana Grande song)	Mariah Carey	Mariah Carey
Grande 's second studio album , My Everything -LRB- 2014 -RRB- , debuted at number one in the US and charted in the top 10 in 24 other countries .	My Everything	My Everything (Ariana Grande album)

With the lead single `` Problem '' and several others from that album , she was continuously in the top 10 of the Billboard Hot 100 for 34 weeks and had the most top 10 singles of any artist in 2014 .	Problem	Problem (Ariana Grande song)

In 2015 , Grande promoted My Everything with her first world tour , The Honeymoon Tour , guest-starred in the Fox comedy horror television series , Scream Queens and released a holiday EP , Christmas & Chill .	The Honeymoon Tour	The Honeymoon Tour	My Everything	My Everything (Ariana Grande album)	Fox	Fox Broadcasting Company	comedy horror	comedy horror	Scream Queens	Scream Queens (2015 TV series)	EP	Extended play	Christmas & Chill	Christmas & Chill
In 2016 , she released her third studio album , Dangerous Woman , and several songs from the album .	Dangerous Woman	Dangerous Woman (album)

The title track debuted at number 10 on the Billboard Hot 100 , making Grande the first person in the history of that chart to have the lead single from each of her first three albums debut in the top 10 .	The title track	Dangerous Woman (song)
The album debuted at number two on the Billboard 200 .
As of January 2017 , Grande 's music videos had been viewed a total of more than seven billion times online .

Grande 's accolades include three American Music Awards , an MTV Video Music Award , three MTV Europe Music Awards and four Grammy Award nominations .	American Music Awards	American Music Awards	MTV Video Music Award	MTV Video Music Award	MTV Europe Music Awards	MTV Europe Music Awards	Grammy Award	Grammy Award
All three of her albums have been certified platinum by the RIAA .	RIAA	RIAA
She has actively supported a range of charities , and has a large following on social media ; she is the second most followed person on Instagram .
In 2016 , Time named Grande one of the 100 most influential people in the world on the annual Time 100 list .	Time	Time (magazine)
